notes.voice_votes: Kentucky fiscal courts vote by voice. When the minutes say 'all voted aye', every present member is recorded as aye with vote_method voice_unanimous. Nays, abstentions, roll calls, and failed seconds are recorded from the minutes text.
notes.verification: Motions were compiled from the official minutes PDFs and spot-checked; every record links to its PDF. Use 'Report an error' on any item that does not match the minutes.
notes.fragments: Some motions are marked as incomplete where the extraction lost the object of the motion (for example, a bare "to approve"). They are kept so the mover, seconder and result stay on the record; the linked minutes have the full wording.
notes.extraction: Meetings marked "hub-2026-11" were added in November 2026 from the county's minutes PDFs by the hub's own extraction and have not yet been independently reviewed; the linked PDF is authoritative. Meetings marked "legacy" came from the original hub compilation.
